title: Final test: the rules on net1 v5, Sage and expliCCit's released policy, test links, once
description: The single run on the test links, before the 2026-11-16 cutoff. Every candidate was fixed on validation: the fixed rule (u = 0.25, exp-rule-net1v5-val-82) and the share rule (k = 0.5, exp-share-net1v5-val-85) on net1 v5 and the fixed rule on the true BDP (release model-net1v5), Sage's released policy (exp-sage-model-24) and expliCCit's released policy as deployed (third_party/expliccit-models), next to all 17 kernel controllers. They run on the five test families (campaign seeds 13 for the training conditions and 31 for the others, as the earlier test runs), the held-out competitors for 60 s, and as 2 and 4 copies for 30 s. Reported: log utility against BBRv3 per family (experiments/rule_report.py), the copies' fairness, and utilization and queueing delay against Sage with the flow alone. No learned net2 passed its gate (exp-net2-ppo-gate-99); one that passes a later gate runs on the test links once, on its own.
prepare: SAGE="$IN/sage/sage/sage.onnx"; echo "fc0d6f1da45e4948ee3d96784642793954ed5e52adc1eddd0c9883d5d8fe2f9e  $SAGE" | sha256sum -c; (cd "$IN/m" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); uv run expliccit train import-expliccit third_party/expliccit-models "$OUT/expliccit" --as-deployed; C=(--policy "rule-v5=$IN/m/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "share-k0.5=$IN/m/share-u0.25-k0.5.onnx" --policy "sage=$SAGE" --policy "expliccit=$OUT/expliccit/policy.onnx"); P=("${C[@]}" --policy "oracle-u0.25=$IN/m/rule-u0.25-oracle.onnx"); experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" test 13 31 all "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60" --split test --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 31 --stock all "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-held-competitors-60"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3,cubic,bbr "${C[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart held-competitors-60 copies-30s && uv run python experiments/copies_report.py "$OUT" && uv run python experiments/sage_report.py "$OUT"
